title: December command and staff changes and transfers

paragraphs.text: Major T. E. BULGER was relieved as Executive Officer by Major R. A. PAPE. Major T. E. BULGER was trans- ferred out of the Battalion. First Lieutenant T. BOYD was relieved as S-1 by First Lieutenant D. R. WEST. First Lieutenant T. R. MINOR was relieved as CO, "E" Co, by First Lieutenant D. E. MARCUM. First Lieutenant T. R. MINOR was transferred out of the Battalion. First Lieutenant G. S. BURGETT was re- lieved as CO, "F" Co, by Captain R. A. HICKETHIER.
